_purpose: Step 3 (AI News Agent v2) section 34 — one illustrative candidate per EditorialCategory, for tests and manual exploration of editorial/preview.py and editorial/policy.py. None of this is real published content or a claim about any real company/product/story; every URL is *.invalid and every fact is invented for the shape of the example, not for accuracy.

samples.title: ExampleCorp ships version 4 of its assistant API
samples.note: A vendor's own announcement of a shipped change.

samples.title: New tool: turns meeting notes into a task list
samples.note: A tool discovered via community discussion, not a vendor announcement.

samples.title: Free tier of ExampleCorp Studio, no time limit
samples.note: Explicit free-tier evidence on the product's own page — what validate_free_deal requires.

samples.note: Must be framed as a report ('хтось поділився...'), never as an established fact about the tool.
